generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster about various subjects on a stormy night, with a red-toned palette on a cream background, in the style of 1950s beauty ads. The poster features a luminous pink donut centrally placed, with pink liquid and white spilled milk dripping from its base, adorned with diamonds and pink sprinkles, and appearing weightless with a holographic icing effect. Emerging from the donut are two female legs in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes, and two hands, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. Beside the donut, an eggplant holds a glowing syringe, a banana holds a glowing syringe, and a red chili wears boxing gloves and holds a syringe. The background is a stormy night with a lightning bolt and abundant mist. At the top, in large, bold, arched mid-century serif font, is the headline "YO PAS CL SLM FF", with a smaller tagline below reading "TU VRGN SLM ACT". Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline.
